title: The Sticky Tags
description: add_tag(tag, tags) appends a tag to a list of tags and returns it. If no list is given, it should start a new one. The first call works...
hint: The tests run one after another in the same program. When is `[]` in the function signature created?
explanation: Default values are evaluated once, when the function is defined, not on every call. All calls without `tags` share the same list, so tags pile up between calls. Use `None` as the default and create a new list inside the function.
